story.heading: Philosophy & Vision
paragraphs: I believe future advantages belong to those who move first while keeping processes disciplined. Every collaboration starts with deep research, clarity on value, and transparent workflows.
My long-term vision is to build an innovation ecosystem that unites generative AI, Web3, and automation, while strengthening roots in automotive, property, and advanced mobility.
